description: Close issue #1046 and every follow-up left by #1042 (e65e7a50) and #1043 (de4cbe8b) in one PR: thread the resolved binary name through the command layer, retire the last repo/checkout disagreement, correct two docs that present ~/.oh as current, select the compose base from effective image mode, and mint the three probes the 2026-09-11 retrospective nominated.

userStories.title: Thread the resolved binary name through the command layer
userStories.description: As an operator, I want every message to name the binary I invoked, so that the CLI never teaches me a deprecated command.
acceptanceCriteria: The active Product or its bin reaches sandbox.ts, lifecycle.ts, tool.ts, harness.ts, update.ts and config.ts
All 33 hardcoded 'oh' literals identified in #1046 read the threaded value
Invoked as agro, a successful install ends with 'next: agro shell <name>'
Invoked as oh, the same install ends with 'next: oh shell <name>'
Error-recovery hints follow the same rule, including sandbox.ts:223,246, lifecycle.ts:248, tool.ts:148,254, harness.ts:127,221
No literal 'oh ' is substituted with a literal 'agro ' — resolution is always dynamic per .agro/cli/src/lib/product.ts:38
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MET. ~90 operator-facing sites threaded across commands/{sandbox,lifecycle,tool,harness,update,config,secret,cloud,self-upgrade}.ts and lib/{registry,project,secrets,env-file,vendor}.ts, lib/execution/{runner,local-target}.ts, lib/{runtimes,tools}/catalog.ts. Scope widened past the issue's 33-site table on evidence: secret.ts and cloud.ts were missing from it, and the whole lib/ layer carried the same defect (proven live by a both-bin smoke test showing `agro secret list` printing 'run `oh update` first'). bin is a REQUIRED option field, so a missed call site is a typecheck error, not a silent legacy fallback. Two mechanisms: a threaded bin where one reaches the consumer (catalog string fields became (bin) => string); activeBin() = resolveProduct(process.argv[1]).bin where the function is deep and no bin can reach it. No literal 'agro' was substituted for a literal 'oh'. Verified by advisor: typecheck clean; both-bin smoke test on a rebuilt dist; and the US-002 probe PASSES on this tree while REGRESSING with 78 hits on a pristine de4cbe8b tree. registry.ts:145 required an operator-authorized scoped edit to the frozen registry.test.ts; see evidence.md.

userStories.title: Probe the binary-name guardrail
userStories.description: As the harness, I want a probe that fails when an operator-facing binary name is hardcoded, so that #1046 cannot recur.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/evals/probes/continual-learning-20260911.sh exists, tier A
It fails when a tracked file under .agro/cli/src/commands/ prints a hardcoded operator-facing 'oh ' or 'agro ' literal
It does not flag --repo-dir, gh CLI flags, or legitimate uses of LEGACY_PRODUCT.bin
It exits 2 with SKIPPED when .agro/cli/src is absent
It passes on the tree produced by US-001 and fails on the tree before it
Tests pass
userStories.notes: MET. .agro/evals/probes/continual-learning-20260911.sh, tier A. Structural regex oracle, not an allowlist. Advisor-verified independently: 78 hits on the pre-fix tree (exit 1), PASS on the fixed tree, cwd-independent, and a 11-form decoy module (oh.json, ~/.oh, OH_HOME, .oh/, /opt/oh/, --repo-dir, gh --repo, ${opts.bin}, LEGACY_PRODUCT.bin, agro-web, oh-compose-env-) produces zero false positives while one real invocation is caught. The worker was told not to exempt the live self-upgrade.ts:191 hit and did not; that site was fixed under US-001 and the probe then went green.

userStories.title: Retire the last repo/checkout disagreement
userStories.description: As a consumer of agro sandbox list --json, I want the key to match the rest of the CLI without my parser breaking.
acceptanceCriteria: SandboxRow carries a checkout key holding the value configCheckout(config) returns per .agro/cli/src/commands/sandbox.ts:349
The repo key remains present with the identical value as a deprecated alias — additive, not a rename
docs/ records that repo is deprecated in the JSON output and names checkout as the supported key
The human-readable table is unchanged
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MET. SandboxRow gained a checkout key; repo retained as a deprecated alias, both fed from one configCheckout(config) const so they cannot drift. Additive, not a rename. Human table byte-identical (advisor-verified: the renderer emits no header row, and the table now reads row.checkout which is the same value). docs/lifecycle-commands.md records the deprecation and names checkout as the supported key; column labels corrected in docs/quickstart.md, docs/installation.md, docs/runtimes/{overview,docker}.md and .agro/cli/README.md. Open question decided: no runtime deprecation marker in the JSON, matching #1043's treatment of --repo.

userStories.title: Correct only the docs that present ~/.oh as current
userStories.description: As a reader, I want the legacy registry path described as legacy, without losing the passages that correctly explain back-compatibility.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/README.md:176 and .agro/cli/README.md:101 name ${AGRO_HOME:-~/.agro}/sandboxes/<name>/ as the current path

Passages that deliberately describe the legacy path as still resolving are UNCHANGED, including docs/configuration.md:27, docs/deployment-prebuilt-image.md:13, docs/lifecycle-commands.md:25 and docs/oh-directory-layout.md:44
CHANGELOG.md history is unchanged
The fresh-machine-setup knowledge page citation rot recorded at .agro/tasks/repo-flag-checkout-rename/evidence.md:284 is corrected
Prose passes the /ste checker
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: MET, with one criterion qualified. The three ~/.oh-as-current sites were corrected and every correctly-legacy passage named in the story was left verbatim; a full sweep classification is in progress.txt. Widened on evidence to docs/runtimes/{docker,overview,microsandbox}.md, two skills, and a live doc bug: the page named /opt/oh-seed and a '[ ! -d $dest/.oh ]' guard, both false, and contradicted the frozen #1042 probe oh-image-only-deploy.sh which asserts a /opt/oh-seed reference is a FAILURE. fresh-machine-setup citation rot corrected (4 citations, each re-grounded; verified_at NOT advanced) and the knowledge index reindexed. QUALIFIED: 'prose passes the /ste checker' is met as 'adds zero new findings', not as exit 0 — every edited file already failed ste-check at the pre-fix tree (advisor-confirmed baselines 35/20/13/44/4/2/20) and reaching zero would mean rewriting ~68 untouched sentences.

userStories.title: Select the compose base from the effective image mode
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want materialize() to choose the compose base from what the sandbox will actually do, so that the #1042 D-3 pin is no longer needed to compensate.
acceptanceCriteria: materialize() selects the build-capable base only when the sandbox will build, rather than whenever checkout is set, per .agro/cli/src/lib/registry.ts:93-99
A unit test asserts which base is written for each combination of (checkout set or unset) x (image.mode build or image)
The D-3 image.ref fill at .agro/cli/src/commands/sandbox.ts:286-292 is removed ONLY if US-005 makes it unreachable, with a test proving a non-checkout path still resolves a runnable image
If the pin cannot be removed safely without a Docker daemon, keep it, say so in evidence.md, and mark this criterion not met rather than guessing
The three compose-string probes and registry.test.ts stay byte-identical
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: REDUCED SCOPE — the behaviour change was DROPPED ON EVIDENCE, which is the path acceptance criterion 4 prescribes and the operator pre-authorized. NOT MET: criterion 1 (materialize() selecting the base from effective image mode) and criterion 3 (removing the D-3 pin). The premise does not hold: the two compose bases differ in the build stanza AND the checkout bind mount (and image/pull_policy defaults), and docker-compose.yml is the only source of ${AGRO_REPO_DIR}:/home/sandbox/harness, so selecting the image-only base for a checkout-set sandbox would boot without the operator's checkout mounted and fail its own healthcheck. FR-7 freezes the compose files, so no third base is possible here. MET: criterion 2 (a unit test asserting the base for all four combinations of checkout x image.mode), criterion 4 (kept the pin, disclosed in evidence.md, marked not met rather than guessing), criterion 5 (registry.test.ts byte-identical for THIS story; its later change was a separate operator-authorized exception under US-001), 6 and 7. Advisor ran an independent inversion of registry.ts:96 -> 5 of 6 tests fail, tree restored green.

userStories.title: Probe the surface-sweep guardrail
userStories.description: As the harness, I want a probe that keeps rename tasks honest about their affected surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/evals/probes/docs-20260911.sh exists, tier A
It fails when a flag or field documented as canonical in docs/ is still presented as canonical under its deprecated spelling in any tracked README.md
It covers repo-root README.md, .agro/README.md and .agro/cli/README.md
It passes on the current tree
Tests pass
userStories.notes: MET. .agro/evals/probes/docs-20260911.sh, tier A. The oracle DERIVES the canonical/deprecated pair from docs/ rather than hardcoding it, and is hard-wrap tolerant — the advisor's own naive single-line grep for the declaration missed all three real sources, which is exactly the trap pattern-evals-prose-literal-pinning records. Advisor-verified in both directions: an unmarked deprecated spelling added to .agro/README.md yields exit 1 naming the line; the same line marked as a deprecated alias yields exit 0. Two worker-declared limits accepted and recorded rather than papered over: --repo is also a gh flag, and derivation is pinned to one phrase shape (which SKIPs loudly rather than passing silently).

userStories.title: Probe the CI-evidence guardrail
userStories.description: As the harness, I want a probe that rejects treating an empty check set as a pass.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/evals/probes/continual-learning-20260911b.sh exists, tier A
It fails when a tracked script or skill treats an empty CI check list as a settled or successful state
It covers .agro/skills/ci-status/, .agro/skills/audit/scripts/ and .agro/skills/spec/references/
It passes on the current tree, or names the exact offending site if it does not
Tests pass
userStories.notes: MET. .agro/evals/probes/continual-learning-20260911b.sh, tier A. The core of the oracle is a behavioural drive of the real tracked pr-classify.sh with an empty statusCheckRollup, not a text pin. Advisor-verified by independent fault injection: deleting the (.statusCheckRollup|length)==0 branch makes the real classifier return ci=PASS promotable=true for zero checks and the probe catches it (exit 1); forcing every rollup into that branch trips the green-rollup control (exit 1), so the oracle cannot be satisfied by a classifier that calls everything NONE. Control restored -> exit 0.

git diff development...HEAD -- .devcontainer/ is empty
.devcontainer/entrypoint.sh is unchanged
A CHANGELOG entry exists per .agro/skills/git/SKILL.md
Tests pass

userStories.notes: MET. /eval: 149 probes, exit 0, NO green->red regression. Three persistent reds all delta=unchanged and pre-existing (two environmental: python3 and cc-safety-net absent). `git diff origin/development...HEAD -- .devcontainer/` is EMPTY. entrypoint.sh and docker-compose.yml match their pre-work digests byte for byte, as do all three #1042 compose-string probes. registry.test.ts changed ONCE under an explicit operator-authorized exception, scoped to two hunks (one assertion plus its required import); before/after digests and the full diff are in evidence.md.
